## Jill integration review — 2026-10-15 (COMMENT; not merge approval)

Reviewed draft PR #13 metadata, committed consolidation report, evidence logs/graph, package integrity audit, and workflow check runs for head `9a94947176416531be2305a4c8a2dfe2a8a89d39`.

**Confirmed:** eight original heads in the documented order #3 → #5 → #6 → #7 → #8 → #9 → #10 → #12, all preserved; 5 foundation + 119 prototype + 69 runner local tests show passing final logs; integrated head has completed successful GitHub checks for Python 3.10 and 3.12. No merge to develop/main. Historical G3/G4 and real-Fusion evidence retained.

**Blocking integration issue independently reproduced in committed import log:** package installed from `src/` can import `vandesign.core.joinery` but not `vandesign.modules.cabinet`; prototype root imports the latter but cannot import `vandesign.core.joinery`. This is not fixed by green separate suites. The project cannot yet claim one working installed V5 runtime. No approval to merge PR #13 in its current state.

**Recommended next *single* focused milestone:** on a child integration branch, migrate the existing V5 modules to one distributable `src/vandesign` package (prefer that package as sole runtime), preserving frozen V5 expressions, parameter names, stable IDs, schema/generator contracts, and existing public DadoShelf API/validation. Keep Fusion-specific imports behind the adapter boundary and provide an explicit, tested deployment path for Fusion runner/launchers. Test actual installed wheel imports in a clean interpreter, legacy compatibility, offline suites and one targeted disposable Fusion smoke test *only if deployment paths changed*. Preserve original prototype and historical G2/G3 evidence; no wholesale refactor or feature expansion.

G0 exact V4 executed-source provenance remains **UNKNOWN**, not silently waived. It can be recorded as a separate explicit experimental-gate decision if Jason wishes to integrate to develop before release qualification; do not claim G0 closed or G5 ready. Similarly, G3 F0/F3, broader G4 change-engine features and formal G5 criteria remain scoped follow-ups.

Do not merge the aggregate PR and sequential stack both. Leave this draft open pending package migration/review and a selected delivery route.
